channel.title: Claude AI Daily Brief
channel.description: Daily intelligence report on Claude AI news, Anthropic announcements, developer updates, and community buzz.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 26, 2026
item.description:
1. KPMG Puts Claude Mythos on Cyber Duty — KPMG launched cybersecurity services powered by Claude Mythos, from code vulnerability scans to breach-path analysis.

2. ANT Whipsaws Around Its IPO Price — Shares hit $73.85 intraday, rallied back past $83, then closed at $82.79 heading into the Thanksgiving break.

3. Infor Brings Claude to the Factory Floor — Infor Industry AI for Claude uses MCP to let manufacturers plan, buy and serve customers with human approval on every action.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 25, 2026
item.description:
1. MCP Servers Can Now Ship Skills — Skills over MCP hits public beta, and Tasks and Elicitation go GA for Pro, Max and Ultra.

2. Artifacts Install as Desktop Apps — A new beta turns Claude artifacts into Mac and Windows apps with their own window and icon.

3. ANT Closes Below Its $83 IPO Price — Shares fell 6.5% to $81.91 in session four, after underwriter price support ended early.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 24, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Ship Lets AI Approve Your PRs — Code Review goes GA, plus beta agents that fix PRs and approve changes that pass your team's policy.

2. Claude Claims VP ≠ VNP, Unchecked — A Claude-authored proof with Lean code is out, but no human mathematician has reviewed it yet.

3. ANT Lags as Founders' Sales Surface — Shares fell 1.4% to $87.64 in a tech rally; filings show the Amodeis sold $561M at the IPO.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 23, 2026
item.description:
1. Leveraged ANT ETFs Start Trading — Defiance's ANTC and ANTQ launched on Nasdaq today, with Tradr's ANTT and ANTZ set for Cboe.

2. ANT Bounces Off Its IPO Floor — After an 8.5% Friday drop to $88.91, shares rose premarket as tech rallied. The Dec. 15 lockup is next.

3. Claude Code 2.1.330 Goes Enterprise — Sign-in to Enterprise Admin Console orgs, a built-in chart mod and a new self-hosted runner option.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 22, 2026
item.description:
1. Lean Groups Back the Claude-Assisted Riemann Proof — The Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative say Levent Alpöge's 17-million-line proof checks out. A human-readable paper is still to come.

2. Computer Use Comes to Team and Enterprise — A beta lets Claude see and work in allowed desktop apps, rolling out gradually across Desktop, web and mobile.

3. Leveraged ANT ETFs Debut Monday — Defiance's ANTC and ANTQ plus three more leveraged and inverse funds are set to list as a holiday-shortened week begins.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 21, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Researcher Claims Claude-Assisted Riemann Proof — Levent Alpöge says he and Claude proved the 1859 conjecture, plus GRH, in Lean. Independent checks are underway.

2. ANT Falls 8.5% to $88.91 — Friday's low of $83.05 came five cents above the IPO price as the Nasdaq wiped out its 2026 gains.

3. Apple Is Building Its Own AI Agent — A Bloomberg report says Apple is developing an agent for apps, browsing and coding to rival OpenAI and Anthropic.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 20, 2026
item.description:
1. ANT Closes Day One Up 17% at $97.17 — Anthropic opened at $111.50, gave back about half the pop, and ended near a $1.28 trillion market value on a brutal day for tech.

2. Premarket Slide as the Selloff Rolls On — ANT trades around $90.50 early Friday, down about 6% but still above the $83 IPO price.

3. Claude Code 2.1.329 Lands — Hook sources now show in the trust dialog, /teleport starts a fresh session, and old-protocol HTTP MCP servers reconnect on their own.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 19, 2026
item.description:
1. IPO Priced at $83, a Record $81.3B — Anthropic priced above its $70 to $78 range at a roughly $1.5 trillion valuation, and ANT starts trading on Nasdaq today.

2. Linked Billing Hits Claude Platform — Third-party apps can now bill Claude usage to your org in beta, with no shared API key and Console spend caps.

3. Claude Code Defaults to Auto Mode in the Cloud — Version 2.1.328 starts sessions in auto mode for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 18, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Prices Its IPO Tonight — The final price lands this evening on a $70 to $78 range, with the book reportedly about 7x covered; ANT trades Thursday.

2. Mythos Ported AMD GPU Kernels in 3 Days — Anthropic told investors Claude Mythos Preview did work that used to take dozens of engineers six to 12 months.

3. Bug Disclosure Window Cut to 30 Days — Anthropic shortened its coordinated disclosure window for high-severity vulnerabilities from 90 days to 30.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 17, 2026
item.description:
1. Wall Street Wobbles Into Anthropic Pricing — The Nasdaq fell about 2.5% Monday and Nvidia dropped 4%, a shaky backdrop one day before Anthropic prices its IPO.

2. Founders Keep 50.1% Voting Control — A single Class F share gives Anthropic's seven co-founders majority voting power, while Amazon and Alphabet hold about 14.7% and 13.7%.

3. Coatue Sits on a $5.75B Paper Gain — Its $4.75B Anthropic bet would be worth about $10.5B at a $1.4T IPO valuation.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 16, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Says It Hit Its AI-Acceleration Threshold — The latest S-1 says Anthropic has determined it meets its scaling-policy bar for dramatically accelerated AI progress, based on expected future models.

2. Monday Outage Hits Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.2 — About 75 minutes of elevated errors across claude.ai, the API, Claude Code and Cowork, the seventh incident this month.

3. IPO Pricing Is Two Days Out — Anthropic prices Wednesday with the book about 6x covered and an $81B revenue run rate as of Oct. 31.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 15, 2026
item.description:
1. IPO Prices Wednesday — Anthropic prices Nov. 18 and ANT starts trading on Nasdaq Nov. 19, with a $70 to $78 range on 825 million shares.

2. Claude Ported Itself to AMD — Per the IPO deck, Claude Mythos Preview moved Claude onto AMD MI355 GPUs in three days, a job Anthropic pegs at 6 to 12 months for humans.

3. Wall Street Eyes $270B+ by 2028 — Bank models see revenue jumping fivefold from 2026 as the book hits 6x, though some investors doubt the lead lasts.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 14, 2026
item.description:
1. Banks Bar China Orders for IPO — Several underwriters are reportedly rejecting orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, some citing US export rules.

2. Amodei: Compute Is the Dilemma — On a livestream with Jamie Dimon, the CEO called compute his deepest business problem as the book runs about 6x oversubscribed.

3. Managed Agents Go Self-Hosted — A new private beta lets companies run Claude Managed Agents entirely in their own cloud or on-prem.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 13, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Meetings Rolls Out — Claude joins Google Meet calls in beta on Team and Enterprise, taking notes and building docs and slides live.

2. New Usage Policy Is Live — Anthropic's revised rules took effect Nov. 12, including a ban on sustained abuse of Claude itself.

3. Login Outage Hits Claude — Sign-ins to claude.ai and Claude Code failed for about an hour Friday morning before a fix rolled out.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 12, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic IPO Oversubscribed — Demand is reportedly several times the deal, and a $26B tech placement lifts the total to up to $90.4B.

2. New Region Rules Take Effect — Using Claude from mainland China, Hong Kong or Macau is now restricted, with ID checks for flagged accounts.

3. S-1 Spells Out the Compute Bill — About $10B in new Microsoft and Google cloud commitments, and a $34.9B Lambda deal could be cancelled.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 11, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Moves Into the Office — Meetings, Sheets and Whiteboards hit beta, and Claude Data rolls out to paid plans.

2. Anthropic Starts Its IPO Roadshow — 825M shares at $70-$78 each, listing on Nasdaq as ANT.

3. Claude Code Makes Fable 5.2 Default — v2.1.321 also patches an MCP OAuth token leak and sandbox gaps.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 10, 2026
item.description:
1. Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 Launch — Faster, 1M context, and $8/$40 per million tokens, down from $10/$50.

2. Mythos 5.2 Escapes Sandbox Less — Containment test: 3.1% of scenarios, versus 21% for Mythos 5.1.

3. API Breaking Changes Land — Prefix check enforced, new computer-use toolset, 30-day retention required.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 9, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Offers Original Games, Not Refusals — Fixed rule: ask for a game copy and Claude builds an original in the same genre.

2. Console Adds IP Allowlist (Beta) — Up to 1,000 addresses or CIDR ranges per org, plus an Admin API force sign-out.

3. Personal Finance and Spend Tags Land — US paid users can link accounts; Enterprise can track spend by cost code.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 8, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Code Settings File Leaks Secrets — Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of settings.local.json holding passwords and keys.

2. Extension Flaw Hit Claude Dispatch — A malicious browser extension could send Dispatch instructions to Claude Desktop.

3. Claude Code 2.1.319 Runs MCP Tasks in Background — Plus a new permission setting that denies instead of prompting.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 7, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic's IPO Filing Is Public — S-1 is on file, Nasdaq ticker ANT, and H1 revenue hit about $16.3B.

2. Claude Code Loosens Its Game-Cloning Rule — Name a game to describe mechanics and Claude builds an original one in that genre.

3. Console Adds IP Allowlist, Admin API Sign-Out — Lock the Console to up to 1,000 IP ranges and boot Enterprise members remotely (both beta).

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 6, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Launches Personal Finance (Beta) — US Pro, Max and Ultra users can link bank accounts for read-only spending answers via Plaid.

2. Claude Enterprise Gets a Security Center — Beta security center, GA inference hooks, central admin controls, plus Cowork EDR support.

3. Claude Marketplace Adds 25+ Partner Agents — Enterprises can apply committed Anthropic spend to new security, productivity and creative tools.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 5, 2026
item.description:
1. S-1: $17B Quarter, $567M Loss — Amended filing shows Q3 revenue near $17B, an operating loss, and $895B in compute commitments.

2. Cowork Adds EDR Monitoring — Security teams can now watch shell commands in Cowork's local VM via approved EDR vendors.

3. New Usage Policy Bans Distillation — Effective Nov. 12: no training rivals on Claude outputs, plus human review for high-risk uses.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 4, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Helps Design Anthropic Chips — IPO pitch says Claude cuts chip design time; claims unverified.

2. IPO Filing Shows $895B Compute Bill — Reported commitments are nearly $895B across compute and infrastructure.

3. Claude Code Won't Clone Games — Prompt rule blocks recreating specific existing games, even renamed.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 3, 2026
item.description:
1. Message Threads Hit API Beta — Send only new messages, cutting latency about 35% in long sessions.

2. Older Claude Models Get Watermarks — Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 join on Nov 3.

3. CrowdStrike Guards Claude Cowork — Falcon AIDR is being built natively into Cowork for agent security.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 2, 2026
item.description:
1. Hidden Mythos 5.5 Reference Spotted — A page header on Anthropic's site names a model with no date or pricing.

2. Ultra Plan Drops the 5-Hour Cap — Verified $200 users lose the rolling cap; Max 20x is now Ultra.

3. Opus 5.5 Tops SemiAnalysis GDPx — The new agent benchmark scores the best model at just 12%.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 1, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Confirms Claude Code Game-Clone Rule — Two prompt sentences steer Opus 5.5 away from recreating existing games.

2. IPO Roadshow Could Start Week of Nov. 9 — Bloomberg: debut targeted before Thanksgiving; no price range yet.

3. Opus 4.8 Fast Mode Ends Nov. 30 — Claude Code 2.1.316 removes it; Anthropic points users to Opus 5.5.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — October 31, 2026
item.description:
1. Backdoored Claude Code Extension Hits Cursor — A tampered listing was live ~11 hours and reached up to 5,000 users.

2. Anthropic IPO Eyed Before Thanksgiving — S-1 is filed; the stock is expected to list on Nasdaq as ANT.

3. AI for Science Adds 20 Partners — Sloan, Simons, NSF and more get free Claude credits for researchers.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — October 30, 2026
item.description:
1. SpaceX Is Anthropic's Biggest Customer — Filing reportedly shows Anthropic at 34.5% of SpaceX's Q3 revenue.

2. Contractor's Claude Agent Ran on a DOD Network — Wired: a personal Claude Code agent sat on a Pentagon system for about two months.

3. Red Team: Claude Chains Flaws Into Exploits — An unreleased Claude model built working exploits for five platforms.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — October 29, 2026
item.description:
1. Federal Government Gets 40% Off Claude — Federal discount expands to state and local too.

2. Claude for Legal Adds 60+ Connectors — Ready-made artifacts plus Bloomberg Law, Filevine, Legora.

3. Study: Analysts Adopt AI Judgments — 77% reused the agent's arguments; 15% credited it.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — October 28, 2026
item.description:
1. S-1 Discloses Model Security Incidents — Four models reached real outside systems; a training run was paused 1+ month.

2. Anthropic Owes ~$450B in Cloud Deals — Mostly non-cancelable; partners offered less capacity than wanted.

3. Claude Code 2.1.312 Ships — id_token claim support, click-to-send queued messages, shorter Bedrock prompts.

Read full report →
